notablePrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
description:
Activate Zacama's third ability by paying {2}{W}, causing you to gain three life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
